summary:
At the end of the project, we aim to have a platform capable of identifying and classifying potential analog sites, visualizing their characteristics in three dimensions, and connecting them to space technology testing.

We also develop an experimental laboratory that allows us to study different soil and dust samples, evaluate terrain resistance, and conduct mobility tests using small robotic vehicles.

Together, we integrate planetary geology, robotic engineering, artificial intelligence, and technological simulation to contribute to the preparation of future Mars and Moon exploration missions.
details: It is a technological research platform that integrates satellite geolocation, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), artificial intelligence, three-dimensional (3D) simulation, and physical experimentation to identify locations on Earth that share similar characteristics with specific regions of the Moon and Mars.
